name: Chimeric Armored Beast
desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a four-legged beast were given a carapace and charging horn like those of an Onikabuto, it might well become a shock force capable of breaking through enemy formations.
In theory, man-made monsters designed around a single function rarely survive in the wild. Once they lose the place or purpose for which they were made, most perish for having defied the laws of nature. Clearly, however, the Armored Beast is not one of them.
Today, on the frozen lands of Snezhnaya, Armored Beasts can often be seen hunting in packs.

dropMaterial.name: Mora
dropMaterial.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

dropMaterial.name: Chimeric Core
dropMaterial.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
This is the most fundamental core grown within a man-made monster. Yet, simple as it may be, it contains the primordial design for the growth of all man-made creations.

dropMaterial.name: Symbiotic Chimeric Nucleus
dropMaterial.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
A relatively complex core harvested from a man-made monster. This symbiotic nucleus is engineered to sustain the biological cycles of two distinct life-forms, seamlessly weaving them into a single organism.

dropMaterial.name: Prime Chimeric Nexus
dropMaterial.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
The most complex core a man-made monster can possibly sustain, serving as an artificially engineered yet flawless seed of life. Whoever brought this creation into life has surely unlocked the very secrets of how life itself is shaped.

customize.text:
In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills.
Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
